logic_description: TODO [STUDY]: delete this example row and add one row per cohort. This column is NOT a label — it is the durable, reviewable rationale for the cohort, and in this workspace it is expected to be long (see pad-amp-nhd-prog/inst/Cohorts.csv for the reference standard). Record, in this order: (1) ROLE — TARGET / OUTCOME / COVARIATE, and which score item or analysis consumes it. (2) REUSED or AUTHORED, and why — if reused, from which study and whether the concept set is an EXACT match or BROADER/NARROWER than what this study needs; if authored, which existing [DVI] cohort you rejected and on what clinical grounds. (3) CONCEPT IDs with Rule 1 provenance and query date, e.g. 4185932 [vocab query] 2026-08-06, plus whether descendants are included. (4) LIMIT and ENDSTRATEGY consequences — 'Limit: First' means the covariate is ever-prior-to-index and CANNOT be windowed; every cohort authored here should be Limit: All at all three levels with EndStrategy StartDate+0 so cohort_end_date equals cohort_start_date. (5) DOMAIN SPAN — if the concept set crosses OMOP domains, say so and confirm there is one primary criterion per domain, because a single-domain criterion silently captures half the definition. (6) alignment_status — one of: matches_dvi / LOCAL ONLY -- NOT YET IN ATLAS / LOCAL AHEAD OF ATLAS. (7) BENCHMARK — the published prevalence this cohort should land near, if one exists, and what a large miss would mean. (8) WHAT WOULD FALSIFY the choice.
